summary: Significant end-to-end latency & request timeouts when function/tool-calling enabled — schema validation extra round-trips
description:
Issue summary:
Customer reports a large jump in end-to-end latency and intermittent request timeouts after enabling function/tool-calling with schema validation turned on. Problem began at ~2026-03-10T09:02:00Z and affects a subset of production traffic on dedicated capacity in us-west-2.

Impact:
- ~15% of CodexSoft production requests that use function/tool-calling now hit 5xx/timeouts or experience p95 latency increase from ~120ms to ~1.2s.
- User-facing timeouts cause failed workflows and support escalations.

Environment:
- Redwood Dedicated pool: codex-dedicated-usw2
- Model variants: redwood-7b-instruct (default), stable-compat-13b (fallback)
- Feature flags: function_calling=enabled, schema_validation=sync (customer default)

Steps to reproduce (customer provided):
1) POST /v1/chat with function_calling enabled and schema validation included in request body.
2) Use prompt that triggers 2-3 function calls (e.g., calendar.lookup -> contact.resolve -> confirm).
3) Observe E2E latency in client and server traces; many requests exceed client timeout (10s) or return 502/504.

Observed behavior:
- p50 is mildly elevated, but p95/p99 spikes dramatically.
- Traces show repeated short RPCs between serving runtime and schema-validator service for each function call; each validation leg adds ~120-300ms.
- When multiple function calls happen in a single session there appear to be additional serial round trips rather than parallelized validation.

Expected behavior:
- Schema validation should not add serial blocking round-trips per function call that multiply with number of calls; validation should be performed locally or batched to keep E2E latency within SLOs.

Relevant logs / traces (examples):
- trace id: tr-7f4a2c45 (user session) — observed three validation RPCs: 180ms, 210ms, 240ms. Total validation time contribution ~630ms.
- s3 logs: s3://codex-logs/2026-03-10/trace-tr-7f4a2c45.json
- console dashboard: https://console.redwood.ai/projects/codex-dedicated-usw2/latency?from=2026-03-10T08:45Z&to=2026-03-10T10:15Z

Notes on scope:
- Issue reproduces for multiple customers that enable sync schema validation with function calls, but CodexSoft has high-volume chains of function calls which make the impact visible.
- No evidence of GPU saturation; CPU and IO metrics for the serving nodes are within expected ranges.

investigation_notes: Metric delta: p95 increased from ~120ms to ~1.2s for affected endpoints between 2026-03-10T08:55 and 2026-03-10T09:05.
Tracing shows schema-validator RPCs are synchronous calls from serving runtime; each function call triggers its own validation call rather than batching or local in-process validation.
Hypothesis A: Schema-validation service single-call latency ≈ 100-250ms; serial calls across 3 functions accumulate and push requests to timeout thresholds.
Hypothesis B: Routing accidentally sends validation RPCs across AZ boundaries for some requests, adding network hop latency — observed in a subset of traces (investigating routing policy).
Load testing: Reproduced on staging with 20% function-calling-heavy traffic; enabling sync validation raised p99 by ~900ms.
No evidence of model runtime slowdown (GPU/CPU normal); root cause isolated to validation RPC path and function-calling orchestration logic.
Related work: runtime PR #2198 proposes batching validation calls per request and adding in-process validation fallback; openshift patch to pin validation service to same AZ to avoid cross-AZ hops.
resolution_notes: Immediate workaround provided to CodexSoft: set schema_validation=async or disable schema validation for high-throughput endpoints; increase client timeout to 30s while patching. Engineering change in progress: PR #2198 implements batched validation and optional in-process validation path (reduction of ~500-800ms p95 in tests). Plan: staged rollout to dedicated pools starting 2026-03-18, monitor for regression. Follow-ups: INT-4567 for runtime fix, add telemetry to detect cross-AZ validation RPCs and fail fast to local fallback, product decision to expose 'validation_mode' with explicit async/local/remote options. Customer will be offered expedited patching on their dedicated pool for acceptance testing.
